context.validated_for: Uncached 64K retrieval and sustained generation with thinking enabled, q8_0 KV, parallel=1, and built-in draft-MTP n=2 / p-min=0.1.

caveats: Measured only on one AMD Radeon RX 6900 XT (gfx1030) through ROCm/HIP under the COMPUTE power profile; do not generalize to RX 9070 XT or other 16GB Radeon cards.
Thinking remained enabled. Retrieval used up to 1024 output tokens so hidden reasoning could finish before the required visible exact answer.

This validates the exact 64K q8_0-KV, b512/ub128, parallel=1, built-in draft-MTP n=2 / p-min=0.1 preset; changing backend, KV precision, parallelism, speculation, batch shape, or power profile is a different lane.
The evidence establishes context fit, retrieval, and sustained generation. It is not a broad capability or answer-quality benchmark.
